evidence.detail: bot.load_extension() requires each module to export a setup(bot) function
48 of 51 command files contain the identical 1-line setup boilerplate
representative example: 'def setup(bot: Client) -> None: Art(bot)' at the bottom of every command file

triage.notes: A scaleless_load fallback exists in __init__.py that avoids needing setup(), but it is only an exception handler, not the primary path. Eliminating setup() site-wide requires changing the extension-loading strategy for all 48 command modules.
